decoded.meaning: ACL{ ACL{ NAME "type" VALUE 0x00, NAME "subject" VALUE "peer-a", NAME "access_mask" VALUE u32=0x00000004 } } — one ALLOW ACE whose mask carries a bit outside READ|WRITE (0x04, the old SUBSCRIBE): every ACE reader REJECTS this record (TYPE_MISMATCH)
decoded.note: RFC-0036 §3.1: the rights registry is READ=0x01 and WRITE=0x02; a mask with any other bit is refused at install, never masked off. The codec round-trips these bytes — the refusal is the reader's, bound by each core's host suite (HARNESS.md)
